title: Adaptive playbook suggester with noise-filter and ephemeral attachments
creator: Aditi Raman
description: Problem: On-call responders spend time assembling context from traces, metrics, and logs after noisy alerts. We need an integration that suggests the most relevant runbook(s) based on signal fingerprints, attaches compact contextual evidence to PagerDuty and Slack notifications, and suppresses repetitive low-value noise. Goal: reduce mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) and mean time to mitigate (MTTM) by surfacing a curated, severity-aware playbook and a short-lived evidence bundle (trace snippet, metric heatmap, recent log tail). The attachment must be ephemeral (TTL 24h) to avoid storage bloat and must obey privacy rules for customer data.
acceptance_criteria: When an alert fires, system generates a ranked list of candidate playbooks (>=1) within 300ms of enrichment start.
PagerDuty events contain a link to an ephemeral evidence bundle and suggested playbook name in the summary and as a PD custom detail.
Slack alert messages (ops channel) include an inline compact attachment with trace snippet (max 3 spans), metric sparkline, and last 50 log lines truncated with pattern redaction.
Noise filter prevents PD paging for alerts matching configured recurrence thresholds and posts a suppressed summary message to a dedicated channel.
Automated postmortem draft is seeded for sev>=2 incidents with prefilled hypothesis checklist and the top 3 related traces attached.
Security: evidence bundle redaction rules and KMS-encrypted presigned URLs are validated and pass a security checklist.
End-to-end test covering Slack + PD + postmortem seeding passes in staging with synthetic alerts.
design_notes: Playbook ranking model: simple rule-based scoring (signal type match + fingerprint similarity + past successful resolution tag) initially, with flags for later ML ranker.

Evidence bundle components: trace snippet (sampling + span condensation), metric heatmap (last 15m, percentile markers), log tail (50 lines, redact PII patterns), and a short timeline summary (3 lines).
Ephemeral storage: presigned S3 URLs TTL 24h, object lifecycle 48h server-side sweep. All objects encrypted with customer KMS per Private deployments; hosted uses Redwood KMS with audit keys.
Noise filter: sliding-window dedupe with exponential backoff per fingerprint. If suppressed, aggregated summary posted every 10m to ops-suppressed channel with counts and topology map.
PD integration: use PD Events v2 payload with custom_details.playbook_suggestion and custom_details.evidence_url. Add quickaction links to runbook and to open postmortem draft.
Slack integration: use ephemeral message attachments where possible and linked thread for followups. Attachments designed for mobile and web readability (no large images).
Permissions: evidence URLs require bearer token with short TTL; tokens rotated and audited. Private deployment must support VPC egress alternatives for presigned URL retrieval.
implementation_plan: 1) Build playbook-indexer that extracts tags from runbooks and produces fingerprint vectors (ENG task).
2) Implement lightweight ranker microservice authors:score-service. Expose /rank endpoint with 300ms SLO.
3) Evidence assembler: trace condenser + metric snapshot + log-tail extractor with redaction library. Limit size to 200KB compressed.
4) PagerDuty adaptor: enrich PD events with playbook suggestion and evidence_url; implement suppression hook logic upstream of PD paging.
5) Slack adaptor: compose compact attachments, post to channel and add thread controls (ack/claim/link-pr).
6) Postmortem seeder: create draft document in Confluence/Drive with metadata and attach links to evidence bundle.
7) Security review and run privacy redaction tests (list of regexes and synthetic PII injection).
8) Integration tests against staging PD+Slack+Confluence, then gradual rollout on Canary team, collect MTTA/MTTM metrics.
Pull requests: PR #1432 implements playbook-indexer, PR #1451 implements evidence assembler, PR #1463 implements PD/Slack adaptors.
testing_plan: Unit tests for ranker with synthetic signal fingerprints and expected playbook order.
E2E staging test that fires a synthetic noisy-alert pattern and verifies suppression + summary delivery.
Manual verification on canary team that Slack attachments render and PD custom_details are searchable.
Load test: generate 200 alerts/s and verify ranker latency P95 < 300ms and evidence assembler CPU <= allocated quota.
Privacy test: run fuzzing with PII injection and assert redaction removal of emails, IPs, and account ids.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal canary (observability + infra squads) for 1 week, monitor MTTA/MTTM and false suppression rate.
Phase 2: opt-in via org-config for customers on Dedicated and Private; collect customer feedback.
Phase 3: default enable for Hosted low-volume tiers with conservative suppression thresholds.
Rollback: disable ranker and evidence bundling toggle; fall back to current PD payload and raw alert body.
